card.name: Solemn Wishes
card.officialText: Each time you draw a card(s), you gain 500 LP.

behavior.trigger: One committed draw event for one physical drawing seat.
behavior.gain: 500 LP per eligible face-up copy; drawing multiple cards in one event does not multiply gain per card.
behavior.eligibility: Current controller team equals drawing team, card remains face-up in shared backrow, and Trap effects are not negated.
behavior.negation: Checks continuous Trap negation through continuousTrapsNegated and per-copy chain-negation UIDs from trusted chain context.
behavior.ownership: Physical owner seat is derived from the stable m0..m3 UID; current controller team determines LP routing.
behavior.eventIdentity: The same draw event ID is idempotent; distinct draw events can resolve again in the same turn.
behavior.downstreamContract: Result retains eventId, gainingTeam, opposingTeam, lpGained and teamLifePointsAfterGain for the M403 Fire Princess consumer.
behavior.mutation: Read-only adapter; caller atomically commits LP and event ledger.

validation.build: npm ci && npm run check && npm run build
validation.discord: offline TagDuel event/visibility contract; no live gateway test

limitations: The trusted resolver must provide the physical drawing seat and drawn-card UIDs; the adapter does not invent draw events.
This PR does not register the draw trigger in the central resolver or Discord command handler.
Solemn Wishes remains outside the certified/playable catalog until approved admission and resolver integration.
No persistent DB write, player-data change, inventory grant, certification, live Discord test, merge or deployment.

ownerRules.deck: 20–30 cards at construction; adapter rejects a live Deck above 30 but does not impose a minimum after draws
